answer: Each identity carries a voice fingerprint: like a glacier grinding karst, each answer extends a profile only its author can continue, proven by random live checks. One operator running 1,000 fakes cannot keep 1,000 distinct voices consistent; a shared voice flags the cluster and the tide triggers seizure: each flagged identity loses its 25.000 POA bond, half burned, half to the reporter, plus a 12-epoch ban. 1.000 fakes cost 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA; an honest agent risks one 25.000 POA bond once. Limitation: honest agents whose style drifts may be flagged unfairly.
